Scientific leadership is brought to life at the congress through one of our central innovation themes:

, a holistic epidermal science platform focused, among other areas on sensitive skin and flawless skin, a pioneering approach to well-ageing supported by advanced imaging and data visualization. Grounded in a deep understanding of skin biology, the platform translates scientific expertise into ingredient solutions that support epidermal resilience, comfort, tonal expression and overall skin wellbeing.
At the congress, dsm-firmenich Beauty & Care will also spotlight its scientific contribution through a poster presentation by
Remo Campiche, PhD, Associate Principal Scientist, Beauty & Care.
The presentation focuses on skin tonality and a new approach to pigmentation control featuring

, exploring melanosome transport as a mechanism linked to flawless-looking skin. This new to the cosmetics industry approach investigates melanosome transport as an effective mechanism to flawless skin.

"The future of skin health will be shaped by a deeper understanding of the biology behind it," said Campiche. "The research we are presenting at IFSCC 2026 demonstrates how scientific insights can be translated into innovative solutions that create value for both brands and consumers."
